title: Control chrono crib — SOC2 prep fragments
content:
Back-of-envelope chronology & quick hits for evidence collection (raw brain dump)

Goal: turn scattered control checks into an ordered, testable sequence so control owners can hand back artifacts with minimal rework. Focus: logs/keystore/VPC access reviews/incident triage pipelines.

1) High-level timeline (proof path)
   - t0: define control objective in one sentence (owner validates). Example: "Production key material is created, stored, and accessed only by authorized services and is rotated on schedule; all key access events are logged and retained 90 days."
   - t1: inventory of systems that hold keys (KMS, HSM, local disk, S3 encrypted objects). Map system -> owner -> evidence artifact.
   - t2: collect configuration screenshots/exports (KMS policy JSON, KMS key metadata, IAM bindings, HSM audit EXTRACT).
   - t3: collect runtime evidence (audit logs, CloudTrail, VPC Flow for access, process audit for rotations).
   - t4: craft test script (one-liner verification steps + expected output).
   - t5: produce a short narrative for auditor: what we expected, what we saw, and why that meets the control.

2) Control mapping sketch (quick columns)
   - Control objective: Key lifecycle, who can create/rotate/destroy
   - Tech slice: KMS + infra automation (terraform state, CI runners)
   - Owner: infra-security@redwood / primary: Priya
   - Evidence types: KMS policy export (kms_policy_2026-02-14.json), CloudTrail filter (cloudtrail_kms_access_2026-02-01-2026-02-28.csv), rotation job logs (rotation-runner-2026-02-03.log)

3) Quick queries to extract evidence (notes for SRE/infra)
   - CloudTrail: eventName = CreateKey OR RotateKey OR DisableKey; filter by resourceType = AwsKmsKey; timeframe = 90d
   - Stackdriver/Logs: protoPayload.serviceName = kms.amazonaws.com AND severity>=NOTICE AND labels.keyId exists
   - DB of rotation jobs: SELECT job_id, status, started_at, finished_at FROM key_rotations WHERE started_at > '2026-01-01' ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 50; export CSV

4) Minimal test script (what auditor will expect)
   - Step 1: show KMS key list + key policy that denies wide principals. Evidence: screenshot + exported JSON.
   - Step 2: run CloudTrail query for create/rotate events in the last 90 days and attach CSV.
   - Step 3: show rotation job log for at least 2 rotations with timestamps and job id; link runner job in CI.
   - Step 4: show a sample access: service X requested decrypt for key K at time T; show IAM role bound to that service and the request in logs.

5) Questions / open risks (need answers before we hand to auditor)
   - How do we document ephemeral keys used by on-prem test harnesses? (owner unknown)
   - Are there any legacy services that still call KMS via shared long-lived credentials? If yes, list and plan to mitigate.
   - Retention: CloudTrail is 365d in S3 bucket A; but the UI extraction step we're giving uses 90d slices. Need to declare retention policy clearly.
   - VPC end-to-end: For key access, do we need to show VPC Flow logs to prove network isolation for sensitive decrypt operations? If so, collect example flows.

6) Evidence naming conventions (to standardize uploads)
   - <control>-<artifact>-<owner>-<YYYYMMDD>.<ext> e.g. kms-policy-kms1-priya-20260214.json
   - logs-<control>-<start>-<end>.csv e.g. cloudtrail-kms-20260201-20260228.csv

7) Sample short narratives (one-liners auditors like)
   - "KMS key abc-123 is owned by infra-security; key policy restricts use to service roles listed in iam-binding-abc-20260214.json; CloudTrail shows no CreateKey events outside infra-security in the last 90 days (cloudtrail-kms-20260201-20260228.csv)."
   - "Rotation for key abc-123 is automated via rotation-runner scheduled cron; logs (rotation-runner-20260203.log) show successful rotation at 2026-02-03T02:15Z."

8) People / ping list (for quick evidence pulls)
   - Priya Sinha (infra-security) — primary key evidence owner
   - Noah Patel (sre) — rotation job logs + CloudTrail queries
   - Jenna Ortiz (platform) — CI job references that call rotation pipeline
   - Legal: Samira (to bless any redactions in screenshots)

9) Small reminders for redaction policy (internal)
   - Redact actual key material (never include private key text). Screenshots should hide key IDs beyond last 4 characters if required by policy.
   - If auditor needs deeper info, request an on-call session with infra owner and ask for read-only access to the S3 export location.

10) Example timeline for 2-week evidence sprint
   - Day 0-1: owners confirm control objective text + evidence map (t0, t1)
   - Day 2-4: SRE/infra run queries and drop artifacts in evidence folder + name per conv
   - Day 5: trust-ops draft narrative per control and attach artifacts
   - Day 6: internal review with legal for any PII redaction
   - Day 7-10: polish and respond to auditor follow-ups

11) Weird edge-case notes (things to flag if asked)
   - Self-hosted HSM: access logs have different format; need mapping script to normalize to CSV for auditor.
   - Customer-managed BYOK: we may need customer confirmation forms; tag these separately.

Open action items (me):
   - A1: run CloudTrail query for KMS events for Feb & Mar, attach CSV to linked JIRA-TS-1298 (TODO by 2026-03-10)
   - A2: draft the "one-line control objective" email and send to Priya (TODO 2026-01-20 — overdue, resend)
   - A3: create evidence folder in shared drive + standard README (owner: Amos)

Notes to self: keep this doc intentionally messy. Everything here will be refined into a per-control checklist and uploaded into CONFLUENCE-8742. When in doubt: produce the query + an example CSV — auditors eat CSVs.

-- end crib --
